data.name: DEADFALL
data.detailed_description:
DEADFALL is a relentless horror wave-survival experience where every round pushes you deeper into a nightmare.

Fight alone or with friends against endless hordes of the infected as you scavenge for weapons, unlock new areas, and struggle to survive against overwhelming odds.

Inspired by classic survival horror and intense zombie wave shooters, DEADFALL combines brutal difficulty, atmospheric terror, and fast-paced cooperative gameplay into one unforgiving experience.

A TRUE HORROR EXPERIENCE

Explore dark environments illuminated only by flickering lights and failing generators. Hear distant screams echo through the darkness.

The further you survive, the worse things become.

SURVIVE ALONE OR TOGETHER

Face the nightmare solo or team up with friends in online co-op.

Coordinate resources, defend choke points, revive fallen teammates and fight together against increasingly deadly waves.

BRUTAL WAVE-BASED COMBAT

The infected evolve as the rounds progress.

What begins as a manageable outbreak quickly escalates into a desperate fight for survival against faster, stronger, and more terrifying enemies.

Survival is not impossible.

Most players won't make it far.

BUILD YOUR ARSENAL

Unlock powerful weapons, discover hidden secrets, and experiment with different strategies to extend your survival.

Every run offers new opportunities to improve your chances.

You'll need every advantage you can get.

HIGH DIFFICULTY BY DESIGN

DEADFALL is built for players who want a genuine challenge.

Resources are scarce.

Mistakes are punished.

Complacency gets you killed.

If you're looking for an easy victory, you're in the wrong place.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op multiplayer

  • Single-player survival

  • Intense wave-based zombie combat

  • Terrifying horror atmosphere

  • Brutal high-difficulty gameplay

  • Powerful weapons and upgrades

  • Hidden secrets and unlockables

  • Dynamic modifiers and game modes

  • Endless replayability

  • Designed to keep you on edge from start to finish

CAN YOU SURVIVE DEADFALL?

No.

Play solo or with friends, unlock devastating weapons, discover secrets, and see how long you can endure the nightmare.

content_descriptors.notes: DEADFALL contains frequent violence and horror themes. Players fight large hordes of infected enemies using firearms, explosives, and melee weapons. Combat features blood effects, depictions of injury, disturbing creature designs, jump scares, and intense scenes of survival horror. The game includes themes of death, infection, and human suffering in a post-apocalyptic setting. There is no sexual content, nudity, or depictions of sexual assault.
